name: Ascendra
tagline: The performance intelligence layer for competitive gaming organizations.
positioning: Ascendra turns raw scrim footage and telemetry into structured coaching decisions for enterprise esports programs and their talent pipelines.

hero.h1: Coaching intelligence, engineered for the podium.
hero.sub: Ascendra unifies scrim review, player telemetry, and roster development into one decision system — so your coaching staff stops chasing VODs and starts compounding wins.

features.title: Scrim-to-signal pipeline
features.description: Ingest every scrim block and match VOD, then surface the three decisions that actually moved win probability — timestamped, tagged, and ready for the debrief.

features.title: Player development ledgers
features.description: Track each athlete against role-specific benchmarks across a season, with objective mechanical and macro trendlines your directors can defend in review.

features.title: Roster telemetry hub
features.description: Connect client, tracker, and scrim data into one governed layer so analysts stop stitching spreadsheets the night before a bootcamp.

features.title: Coaching workflow engine
features.description: Assign film homework, confirm completion, and close the loop from insight to practiced habit — auditable across your entire coaching org.

features.title: Talent scouting index
features.description: Evaluate prospects and academy players with the same rubric as your starters, ranked by projected fit against your existing roster's shape.

features.title: Enterprise governance
features.description: SSO, role-based access, and per-team data isolation built for multi-title organizations and their compliance requirements.

testimonials.quote: We were paying three analysts to rebuild the same scrim report every week. Ascendra collapsed that into a single review artifact our head coach trusts before he even opens the VOD.
testimonials.name: Marek Halvorsen

testimonials.quote: The player development ledgers ended the argument about who was actually improving. We renewed two contracts and released one on data our owners could read in five minutes.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkatraman

testimonials.quote: Onboarding four academy teams onto one governed telemetry layer used to take a full split. With Ascendra it took an afternoon, and the isolation controls passed our security review.
testimonials.name: Tobias Krause

pricing.blurb: For single-title organizations formalizing their coaching workflow.
For multi-title orgs scaling analysts across an academy pipeline.
For leagues and enterprise ownership groups with governance mandates.

homepage.footerBlurb: Ascendra is the performance intelligence layer behind competitive gaming's most disciplined coaching organizations.
